$comment: The one list of retired brand colours (brand ledger D44). Every retired-literal gate reads this file:
and designesy/score-action, which fetches it at a pinned commit. Edit the list here and nowhere else.
It lives inside apps/site because the site gate runs in the Vercel build, which may upload only apps/site.
hex: six digits, lower case, no '#'. Each also matches with an alpha pair (#rrggbbaa), in any case, and
never as the first six digits of a longer hex. rgb: a channel triple matched as rgb() or rgba(), with
commas or spaces, so rgb(1 51 203 / .4) is caught too. selfTest: strings every consumer must match
(mustMatch) and must not match (mustNotMatch) before it scans anything, so a consumer whose patterns
drifted from this file's meaning fails instead of reading clean.

hex.why: old --signal-light blue (D19, D37); the light tint is now #36A7FF, and a grade never takes a brand colour
